name: Construction Industry Levy and Construction Workers Registration Levy
name_zh_hk: 建造業徵款及建造業工人註冊徵款
standard: Construction Industry Council Ordinance (Cap. 587); Construction Workers Registration Ordinance (Cap. 583)
review_status: Rates and threshold from cic.hk (Construction Industry Levy). Pending review by a Hong Kong quantity surveyor.
scope_note: Due on construction operations whose value exceeds HK$3,000,000 (works tendered or begun from 30 July 2018; HK$1,000,000 before). Above the threshold the levy is on the whole value.
description: Construction Industry Levy 0.5 percent and Construction Workers Registration Levy 0.03 percent of the value of the construction operations, 0.53 percent together. Hong Kong has no VAT or GST, so a bill carries no tax line.
